newsitem.title: SWEDEN: No big forecast changes in Sweden budget-finmin.
newsitem.headline: No big forecast changes in Sweden budget-finmin.

text.p: Sweden's Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said on Wednesday that he did not expect any dramatic changes to economic forecasts in the spring budget that will be presented in April.
"I can't give any exact figures but I can say that we will show a better growth forecast for 1997 than we did in September 1996," Asbrink said in a speech.
In the budget presented in September the government estimated GDP growth of about 2.3 percent for 1997.
"There will be no dramatic changes regarding our forecasts about the Swedish economy," Asbrink said.
